page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8y.32xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal instance powered by the proprietary Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor running on the arm64 architecture. The server provisions 128 dedicated physical cores clocked at 2.75 GHz paired with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per core. By eliminating hypervisor-level abstraction, the bare-metal architecture delivers full resource isolation and consistent compute throughput without multitenancy overhead.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring persistent workloads to attach remote cloud block storage volumes. It also contains zero GPU acceleration hardware. For external communication, it provides a 64 Gbps baseline network throughput, providing substantial network capacity for distributed environments and interconnect-heavy systems.

This server provides significant core density and energy efficiency derived from its ARM-based Yitian silicon. It is suited for parallelized cloud-native workloads, microservices architectures, large container clusters, and distributed data processing frameworks optimized for 64-bit ARM platforms.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8y.32xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal server powered by the 64-bit ARM Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor operating at 2.75 GHz. It delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 512.0 GB of memory, yielding a 4.0 GB per core allocation. The server provides 64 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to support high-throughput data transfer across distributed nodes. Local disk storage is not bundled, necessitating external block storage attachments for persistent state, and no GPU acceleration is present. Operating without virtualization overhead, the bare-metal platform offers predictable compute performance and dense resource distribution. It is structured for arm64-compatible enterprise workloads, highly parallel cloud-native applications, containerized fleets, and backend data services.
